name: Wang/Stein 2009 biexponential clinical TGI model (NSCLC)
description: Two-phase (shrink + regrowth) clinical tumor-size model y(t) = y0*(exp(-ks*E*t) + exp(kg*t) - 1), where ks is the drug-driven shrinkage rate scaled by drug effect E and kg the regrowth rate. Yields the Stein growth-rate-constant and the on-treatment tumor-size metrics. ATTRIBUTION: this biexponential form is the Stein-Fojo growth-rate-constant model (Stein 2008, f = exp(-d*t) + exp(g*t) - 1; derived on castration-resistant prostate cancer measured by PSA). Wang 2009's NSCLC registrational analysis used a related but DISTINCT 'mixed exponential-decay + linear-growth' parameterization, not this biexponential; this record borrows the Stein-Fojo structure and cites Wang for the NSCLC tumor-size -> OS context (the week-8 change predictor). Values are illustrative NSCLC-scale and unverified. See docs/verification/workhorse-models.md SS2.

extraction.source_locator: magnitude consistent with the Stein-Fojo growth-rate constant g (Stein 2008, open access PMC3313464: median ~0.022/week, ~1500-fold spread); cohort was prostate/PSA, so this is a cross-tumor magnitude anchor for an NSCLC-illustrative context, not a same-context fit; docs/verification/workhorse-models.md SS2; PDF sign-off pending
extraction.tier_rationale: Growth-rate constant is the strongly prognostic, well-identified term.

parameters.label: tumor shrinkage rate constant (per unit effect)

extraction.source_locator: magnitude consistent with the Stein-Fojo regression rate constant d (Stein 2008, open access PMC3313464: median ~0.14/week, ~50-fold spread); cross-tumor magnitude anchor (prostate/PSA cohort), not a same-context fit; docs/verification/workhorse-models.md SS2; PDF sign-off pending
extraction.tier_rationale: Shrinkage rate depends on drug/dose; moderate identifiability.
